editorial:
Imagine breaking into a fancy mansion thinking you hit the jackpot, only to realize the owners are way crazier than you are. That is exactly what happens to a group of young thieves who think they are playing a simple game of steal and run. Instead of calling the police, the wealthy owners decide to turn the whole night into a sick game of hide and seek. You get to follow these kids as they realize they are not the predators anymore, but the prey. The vibe is tense and scary, making you feel the panic as they run through the dark woods and halls of the estate.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about who will survive. The action is snappy and the twists keep the story moving quickly. While some of the dialogue feels a bit stiff, the suspense makes up for it. If you enjoy movies where the bad guys get a taste of their own medicine, you will love this.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal fight for survival. After most of the gang is killed off, the final survivors manage to turn the tables on the wealthy owners. They use the owners' own traps and weapons against them in a bloody showdown. In the end, the hunters become the hunted, and the cruel proprietors are killed. The survivors escape the estate, leaving behind a trail of bodies and a ruined legacy of wealth and evil.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival games and cat-and-mouse thrillers.
